pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Weather is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weather with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Weather.
   D. Say Weather never happens in Kenya.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   B. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Mass Wasting is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mass Wasting with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Mass Wasting never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Mass Wasting as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Mass Wasting.

6. Which statement about Climate is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Climate with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Climate as rumours only.
   C. Say Climate never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Climate.

7. Which statement about Soils is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Soils with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Soils.
   C. Say Soils never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Soils as rumours only.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

9. Which statement about Vegetation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation.
   C. Treat Vegetation as rumours only.
   D. Say Vegetation never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in.
   B. Say Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

12. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   B. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Soils and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Water Cycle and Action of Rivers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Wildlife and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. A — Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. D — Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. B — Explain symbols used on a map

9. A — Explain Vegetation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. C — Nairobi

12. B — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Soils; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Agriculture - Wheat in Kenya and Russia - Maize in Kenya and Mexico, - Coffee in; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Wildlife; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
